intelligence.essence: One app, four doors: Personal, Business, Space, Membership. Each contains the others. All synced. The membership's front door is the login; the rest share one banner, clearly labeled.
intelligence.human_view: The architecture: NESTED — every door holds the others inside it; a personal page can hold a membership, a business can hold one, a membership can hold a business, a personal, the community, the running feed. SYNCED — change it in one place, it's true everywhere. THE DOORS — Membership's front door is the login, the portal; Personal, Business and Space share the same banner and bones, but it's unmistakable which world you're in. FROM ANY DOOR, EVERY DOOR — move freely between them. On every page: sign up to NayaNET linked to that page's URL; installable as an app; one stats language, same format everywhere; scheduler and journal for that world; appointments schedulable across worlds; any past day reviewable with its stats. The gate: creating a membership takes Pro or Max.
intelligence.simple_view: Four doors, one house, and every room has the other rooms inside it. Whichever door you walk in, everything you own is there, and it all stays in step.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, picture one lovely home with four front doors, and whichever door you come in by, all your things are right there — your letters, your calendar, your people. Nothing is ever in the other house, because there is no other house.
intelligence.naya_view: This is the spec I build doors against: nesting is not a metaphor, it's a containment requirement — any page type can host any other; sync is an invariant, not a feature; the membership login-door and the shared labeled banner are the two identity rules. Shawn's spec, 2026-11-05 ~01:30Z.
intelligence.ai_view: Spec: doors={personal,business,space,membership}; containment=complete (every door can contain every door type incl. feed); sync=global invariant; membership.entry=login; others.banner=shared+labeled(world); per_page=[signup_bound_to_page_url, installable, stats_format=single, scheduler, journal, cross_world_appointments, day_review_with_stats]; membership_creation_gate=Pro|Max.
